articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.snippet: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin dips to $81,000 as stocks slide, VIX soars ahead of Black Monday anniversary
articles.snippet: A Friday surge in oil prices hit already-shaky equity markets, sending the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
articles.snippet: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

articles.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
articles.snippet: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.

articles.title: Bitcoin may seek 20-month trend line reclaim before new record highs: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s market cycle signals tool showed BTC price action copying history, possibly preparing to reclaim a key moving average before testing new highs.
